question.prompt: Calculate \((-2)^4\) and \((-1/2)^3\). (Give your answers in order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: An even power of a negative number is positive: \((-2)^4=16\); an odd power of a negative number is negative: \((-1/2)^3=-1/8\).
solutions.title: Use the sign rules for powers
